FQCOMBAT.DebugSettingHint: Writes the module's debug messages to the browser console. Off by default.
FQCOMBAT.DeathSaveSettingHint: When a character at 0 hit points starts their turn, the death saving throw is rolled automatically: three successes bring them back to 1 hit point, three failures kill them and remove them from combat, otherwise their turn is skipped. A minion at 0 hit points vanishes (token removed from combat and from the scene); an NPC at 0 hit points leaves the combat, its token staying on the scene unless the next setting removes it.
FQCOMBAT.DeleteNpcTokenSetting: Remove NPC tokens from the scene
FQCOMBAT.DeleteNpcTokenSettingHint: When an NPC at 0 hit points leaves the fight, its token is also deleted from the scene, like that of a vanishing minion. Player characters are never affected: a dead character always leaves a body. No effect while death saving throws are off. Off by default.
FQCOMBAT.GMMustBeConnected: GM Must Be Connected for FQCardEngine module
FQCOMBAT.RollInitiativeSettingHint: Roll Normal Initiative In start combat and cards creating minions
FQCOMBAT.TurnTimerSettingHint: Counts down the turn of every combatant owned by a player, and hands over to the next combatant when the time runs out. The countdown is shown in the combat tracker, the same for everyone, and Foundry's pause freezes it. Turns led by the GM are not timed, and neither is the turn of a combatant at 0 hit points. Off by default.
FQCOMBAT.TurnTimerDurationSettingHint: How long a player's turn lasts before the timer hands over to the next combatant. A new duration applies to the turn under way, not just the next one.
FQCOMBAT.TurnTimerExpired: {name} runs out of time: turn handed over
